messages:
Amelia: Heads-up — QBR for BlueMap is Friday next week. Need a concise token-econ snapshot + one pager on potential spend surge mitigations. Can folks own pieces? :calendar: 
Ravi: I can take the spend forecast + commit vs pay-as-you-go scenarios. Will need last 30 days token split by endpoint.
Jordan: I’ll pull usage patterns from the onboarding cohort and highlight embed-heavy routes (likely cause of the spike).
Tessa: From BlueMap side, we have a demo next Tue and might push a vanity search that hits embeddings. Notified product.
Amelia: Good — please tag risky routes. Also capture any feature flags we can flip for a quick cost-safety release.
Miguel: Quick FYI, we already have an autoscale cap set at 8 GPUs for their Dedicated cluster. But burst traffic bypassed it via hosted fallback last month.
Priya: I’ll draft recommended guardrails: rate limit per-user, prefix-KV caching for repeat queries, and a canary for the demo release.
Ravi: Link to my sheet (wip): https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/blueMap-qbr-forecast (view only for now). I added a tab with simple unit-cost calc: `tokens * cost_per_token + embeddings * cost_embedding`.
Jordan: Snagged query to extract endpoint splits: ```sql
SELECT endpoint, SUM(tokens) as tokens, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) as users
FROM usage.events
WHERE account_id='blueMap' AND ts >= now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY endpoint
ORDER BY tokens DESC;
```
Amelia: Perfect. Can we produce 3 scenarios? baseline, demo spike (x3 embeddings), and worst-case sustained x2 for 7 days.
Ravi: Baseline and demo spike done. Worst-case is trickier — running model variant fallback assumptions. Jordan, can you map which requests can downgrade model without impacting core UX?
Jordan: I can flag non-critical routes that can use smaller model or quantized variant. Will annotate the sheet with route tags.
Tessa: BlueMap needs a slide for the QBR that shows actionables we can ship in 48h if spend looks off. Suggest: temp throttle, demo feature flag, and limit top-10 power users.
Priya: I’ll write the ship-48h runbook and the exact API knobs (examples below).
Priya: Example quick throttle snippet: ```json
{
  "route": "/api/embeddings",
  "max_per_min": 60,
  "per_user_limit": 5
}
```
Miguel: Ops note — if we enable per-user caps, we should also route alerts to BlueMap CSM and our oncall channel. I’ll add a monitor.
Ravi: Added forecast numbers to the sheet and a short note on renewal risk if we exceed 120% of committed spend for 2 consecutive months.
Amelia: Awesome. Last asks: Jordan, deliver annotated route list by EOD tomorrow. Ravi, finalize numbers and heatmap. Priya, runbook draft by EOD today. I’ll compile a one-pager for the QBR. :memo: 
cs-bot: Reminder — QBR pack due in #customer-success by 2024-06-05 09:00 UTC.
Tessa: Thanks team — I’ll prep BlueMap slides on our side and share any demo changes asap. :thumbsup:
Amelia: Thanks — will follow up with a quick 15-min sync if we need clarifications. :eyes:
